# Texton [🌐](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Texton)

## Highlights
> [!info]  [🔆](https://read.readwise.io/read/01hs96ha4yj69beddekeae34aa)  
> The term ***texton*** was introduced by [Béla Julesz](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/B%C3%A9la_Julesz) in 1981 to describe "the putative units of pre-attentive human texture perception."[[Jeremy Banthem]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Texton#cite_note-1) The term reemerged in the late 1990s and early 2000s to describe vector quantized responses of a linear [filter bank](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Filter_bank).[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Texton#cite_note-2)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Texton#cite_note-3)
